claims.text: 2 MMR doses give effective protection; breakthrough infections still occur, esp during outbreaks
claims.quote: Clinicians should counsel patients that 2 doses of MMR vaccination provide effective protection against mumps, while breakthrough infections can still occur, particularly during outbreaks.

claims.text: CDC (2018): third MMR dose for people w 2 prior doses whom public health identifies as @ ↑risk during an outbreak
claims.quote: In 2018, the CDC recommended administration of a third MMR vaccine dose for individuals who previously received 2 doses and whom public health authorities identify as having an increased risk of mumps during an outbreak.
